record.field: Answers and forks 16 kHz mono L16 audio to the Pipecat sidecar.

<extension name="pipecat_agent_{{ agent.id }}"> <condition field="destination_number" expression="^{{ number }}$"> <action application="answer"/> <action application="sleep" data="500"/> <action application="export" data="odoo_pipecat_agent_id={{ agent.id }}"/> <action application="export" data="odoo_exten_id={{ agent.exten.id if agent.exten else '' }}"/> <action application="set" data="MOD_AUDIO_BASIC_AUTH_USERNAME=pipecat"/> <action application="set" data="MOD_AUDIO_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD={{ service_token }}"/> <action application="set" data="api_result=${uuid_audio_fork(${uuid} start {{ ws_url }}/ws?call_uuid=${uuid}&agent_id={{ agent.id }} mono 16k pipecat {} true true 16000)}"/> {% if record_calls and recording_url %} <action application="set" data="RECORD_STEREO=true"/> <action application="set" data="media_bug_answer_req=true"/> <action application="record_session" data="{{ recording_url }}/${uuid}.wav"/> {% endif %} <action application="park"/> </condition> </extension>
